script: Pittsburgh are 4-point underdogs, balanced offence (-0.0% PROE), implied 16.5; throw 70% when down 10+, soft run lane (O-line vs front).

Denver are favoured by 4, balanced offence (+0.9% PROE), implied 21.0; red zone trending run (47% last 3 vs 57% season), tough run lane, soft vs TEs, drives die on 3rd down (82% of failed 3rd downs end in a punt or FG; 41% of drives punt, 14% settle for FGs).
Expected volume: Pittsburgh 64 plays / 30:40 possession · Denver 60 plays / 30:04 possession. More plays and possession = more time on field for every prop.
Replacement quarterback for PIT: their passing and receiving legs are held off the tickets; rushing legs stay, and their backs' touchdown prices carry the backup-QB haircut.
rules: Slips are built around the mismatches: at least half the legs come from strong matchups where the game has them.
Weather: rain, 38°F, wind 17 mph: backs up a step, passing game down a step.
Each leg is set by its matchup: a strong mismatch steps up a rung (66%+), a neutral matchup takes a floor rung (75%+), a weak one stays conservative (80%+).
Every props leg is a rung a sportsbook lists, at its listed price; receptions start at 2+.
At most one leg under 65% and at most 2 legs per player.
Props slips carry no touchdown leg; SGP + anytime TD slips carry exactly one, from a scorer the algorithm clears for parlays.
